breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. It correctly calculated the axial velocity from the inlet conditions (Va = 150 * cos(45) = 106.07 m/s) and stated it was constant. However, it then proceeded to use the original, inconsistent outlet velocity (W2=100 m/s), which implies a different axial velocity (Va = 100 * cos(30) = 86.6 m/s). The ground truth resolves this by recalculating W2 based on the constant axial velocity. The agent simply used the contradictory values, thereby failing to fix the inconsistency.
